name: lifestyle-demand-validation
title: Lifestyle Demand Validation — Physical-Guide Market Test
description: Validation track that runs parallel to the routines-app engineering initiative. Tests whether the physical-guide market (cleaning / maintenance / inspection books, planners, whiteboards for Type-B users) is real — via landing-page tests, Amazon KDP print-on-demand, or short-form content — using the routines-app v0 curated routines as source material. Produces the signal that activates (or rejects) the lifestyle bundle's consumer-products revenue line. Full design and decision criteria documented in the uploaded orchestration-summary.md.
